decision: Embed versioned core guidance and serve the same editor tools through a loopback preview bridge
why: The default browser may lack WebMCP and must retain the actual editable state; an iframe avoids website-to-loopback requests
result: One browser owns the session; native WebMCP and bridge reuse revision checks

decision: Run the transport integration server in Node and retain Bun as test runner
why: Bun HTTP emulation did not produce Node response-close semantics on disconnect; production is Node 22+
result: Eight transport tests passed against real Node; initial Bun failures retained in work history

decision: One visible browser tab owns each local session
why: Avoid silent cross-browser state divergence and preserve human edits through existing revision checks
result: Built-in panel and default browser both connected with nine tools and applied follow-up edits
